info.name: RiceFlow API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the RiceFlow backend (Django REST Framework), live at https://api.riceflow.me.

**How to use**
1. Collection variables: fill in `farmer_email`/`farmer_password` (a test farmer account) and `admin_email`/`admin_password`. Keep passwords in the **Current value** column only, so they are not shared.
2. Send **1. Auth > Login (farmer)** and **Login (admin)**. The tokens are saved for you.
3. Go down the folders in order. Create, scan, recommend and guide requests save the ids (`farm_id`, `scan_id`, `recommendation_id`, `guide_id`, `cycle_id`, ...) for the next request.

Every URL ends with `/`. Lists may come in pages (`results`, `next`). Folder 9 uses the free Gemini quota. Folder 13 changes live data and is locked.

item.name: 0. Health
item.description: Is the server and its database up? No login needed.

request.description:
Returns `status`, `database` and `version` (the deployed git commit). 503 if the database is down. Used by the CD pipeline to confirm a deploy.

Who: anyone (no token).

item.name: 1. Auth (accounts)
item.description: Sign-up, login with JWT, profile, token refresh, logout and forgot password.

request.description:
Creates a farmer account. Gmail addresses only (`@gmail.com` / `@googlemail.com`), otherwise 400 on `email`. The barangay is taken later from the first farm pin.

Who: anyone (no token).

Returns `user`, `access_token` and `refresh_token`. **The test script saves the token into `access_token`**, so every farmer request after this works without copy-paste.

Fill in `farmer_email` and `farmer_password` in the collection variables first. Too many failed logins return 429.

Who: anyone (no token).

Same login, for the admin website account. **Saves the token into `admin_token`**, used by the Admin folders.

Fill in `admin_email` and `admin_password` in the collection variables first.

Who: anyone (no token).

The signed-in user's account: name, email, phone, barangay, `has_farm`.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

Changes the user's own name or phone.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

Access tokens expire. Send the refresh token to get a new access token (saved by the test script).

Who: anyone with a refresh token.

Blacklists the refresh token so it can no longer be used.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

Emails a 6-digit code (from noreply@riceflow.me). The reply is the same whether or not the email is registered, so it does not reveal who has an account. At most 1 code a minute and 5 a day.

Who: anyone (no token).

Sets the new password with the emailed code. A code lasts 10 minutes and 5 wrong tries. Success logs the account out on every device.

Who: anyone (no token).

item.name: 2. Farms
item.description: The farmer's farms. The barangay is set by the server from the pin (official NAMRIA/PSA boundaries).

request.description:
Is this pin on farmland, and in which Panabo barangay? Flags roads, buildings, water and mangroves.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

Saves a farm. `ecosystem` is `irrigated_lowland`, `rainfed_lowland` or `upland`. **Saves the new id into `farm_id`.**

Note: this writes to the live database; use a test account.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

Lists only the signed-in farmer's farms. **Saves the first farm's id into `farm_id`.**

request.description:
One of your farms. Another farmer's farm returns 404. The same URL also takes PUT (full edit) and DELETE (remove your farm).

item.name: 3. Environmental scan and weather
item.description: Soil, weather, rainfall, elevation and flood risk for a farm.

request.description:
Reads soil (OpenLandMap saved data, SoilGrids as backup, BSWM soil series for texture), weather and rainfall (Open-Meteo) and elevation, in parallel. Saves one scan row and returns it with `soil_sampling`. **Saves the scan id into `scan_id`.** Takes up to about 20 s.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

exec: if (v !== undefined && v !== null) { pm.collectionVariables.set('scan_id', v); console.log('scan_id =', v); }

request.description:
Every scan of the farm, newest first.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

Current weather, the next 8 hours, and `outlook` (rain, wind and heat for the next 6/24/48 hours) used by the planting guide's weather warnings. Cached 10 minutes per ~1 km area (`X-Cache` header).

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

Average rain per month (Jan-Dec) over the last 3 full years, from the Open-Meteo archive. The planting calendar is built from this.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

item.name: 4. Recommendations (RSI + K-Means)
item.description: Rice Suitability Index scoring with weighted rules (WLC) and K-Means cluster labels.

request.description:
The weights and FAO-style S1/S2/S3 ranges for the 12 factors (soil pH, texture, rainfall, temperature, ...). Stored in the database and edited by the admin.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

Scores every variety for the scan with the RSI, ranks them and returns the top 3 with `rsi_score`, `suitability_class`, `factor_scores`, `variety_cluster` and a plain-language `fit_explanation`. **Saves the id into `recommendation_id` and the top variety into `variety_id`.**

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

item.name: Next crop from the last top 3

request.description:
Starts the next crop from the latest top 3 without a new scan. 409 when a new scan is needed (season changed, scan over 184 days old, or the farm was edited).

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

item.description: The NSIC rice variety catalog and its reference tables.

request.description:
The active varieties (17). Staff can add `?all=1` to include inactive ones.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

Pest and disease reference list. Optional `?type=pest` or `?type=disease`.

item.name: 6. Planting guide (PalayCheck)
item.description: The step-by-step guide from DA-PhilRice booklets (PalayCheck 2022 for irrigated, direct-seeded booklets for rainfed and upland). No AI writes the steps.

request.description:
Builds the guide for the chosen variety, timed to its maturity. `variety` (optional) must be one of the recommendation's top 3. `language`: `en`, `fil` or `ceb`. **Saves `guide_id` and the first open step into `step_id`.**

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

item.name: 7. Crop progress and harvest
item.description: Crop cycles, field logs (steps, problems, notes) and the harvest record.

request.description:
The farm's crop cycles, each with today's `stage`. **Saves the first cycle into `cycle_id`.**

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

exec: if (v !== undefined && v !== null) { pm.collectionVariables.set('cycle_id', v); console.log('cycle_id =', v); }

request.description:
One cycle: variety, season, planting and harvest dates, status. The same URL also takes PUT, PATCH and DELETE.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

Normally started by the recommendation and guide. A farm has one active cycle at a time (400 otherwise). `season`: `wet` or `dry`.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

The cycle's field logs, newest first.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

Saves a field log. With `problem_key` (from Advice > Problem list) it is a reported problem: it shows on the admin dashboard's "Problems this week". `issue_type`: pest, disease, weather, nutrient, other. `severity`: low, medium, high. With `guide_step` it finishes that guide step. **Saves the id into `log_id`.**

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

request.description:
"Okay na": the problem card leaves the guide and the admin dashboard. The same URL also takes GET, PUT and DELETE.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

The cycle's harvest. 404 until the harvest is recorded (that is expected for a growing crop).

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

Saves the harvest, marks the cycle completed, saves the model's prediction beside it for comparison, and every 5th new harvest retrains the yield model. PATCH the same URL to correct it.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

item.name: 8. Yield prediction (Linear Regression)
item.description: Predicts tonnes per hectare from the farm's scan and the variety.

request.description:
Returns `predicted_yield_t_ha`, the model used and its R². With `farm_id`, the prediction is saved for that farm's crop so it can be compared with the real harvest.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

Every training, newest first, with its scores; `is_active` marks the model in use.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

item.name: 9. AI (Gemini) - uses daily quota
item.description: GeoRice AI. Each call uses the free Gemini quota (shared by all farmers), so send these only once during the demo.

request.description:
Answers from the DA-PhilRice booklets (File Search) using the farm's scan, variety, crop day, current guide step and weather. `sources` lists the booklet pages used. 429 at the farmer's daily limit, 503 when Gemini is busy.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

item.name: Explain a problem for my farm

request.description:
The AI explains the problem's booklet cards for this farm. Every point must cite a card; answers naming a chemical or dose are rejected by code.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

item.name: Match the farmer's words to a problem

request.description:
Matches free text (any of the 3 languages) to at most 3 problems from the list. Works without AI too (keywords).

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

item.name: 10. Problem advice (booklets, no AI)
item.description: Official PhilRice/PalayCheck advice cards, each line with its booklet and page.

request.description:
The 9 problems plus "Not sure", for the picker.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

How to identify it, when it is serious, what to do now, what not to do, next season, and where to get help, each with sources.

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).

item.name: 11. Notices
item.description: Messages to the farmer from admin actions (shown in the app's bell).

request.description:
The farmer's notices from the last 30 days (farm removed, variety updated, ...).

Who: any signed-in user (farmer token).
